title: madhuca rupicola
intro: Madhuca rupicola, commonly known as the mountain mahua, is a plant species belonging to the Sapotaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Madhuca rupicola include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to manage conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedation, analgesia, and anti-inflammatory effects.
